payload.summary: Hardened release validation completed: 46-case suite (44 passed and two POSIX-only skips on Windows), cross-platform CI and Chromium, clean package install, real Windows installation adopting 17 accessible repositories with no repeated-install errors, immediate integrated git-init bootstrap, native installed hook commands, filesystem activity and handoffs. Configured verification is current and integrated. Actual model-backed host reload/trust and multi-day running are explicitly outside this QA claim.
payload.next: Publish v0.2.0 and restart/trust the installed integrations in the coding hosts.
